forms.title: Malawi e-Visa application (Department of Immigration and Citizenship Services)

readAs.visaType: Single Entry / Multiple Entry - 6 Months / Multiple Entry - 12 Months

forms.stoppedAt: The application form needs an e-Visa account (Apply for e-Visa redirects to the login page). The public Visa Eligibility Wizard, which states the requirements before applying, was read for a Polish ordinary passport, tourism.

steps.name: Visa Eligibility Wizard (public, before login)
notices: Ordinary Passport this document should be presented at Port of Entry
The Travel document should be valid for 180 days and bear at least 2 blank pages
Fee : 50.00 USD Payable online at the time of application and is non-refundable. (Single Entry; Multiple Entry - 6 Months: 150.00 USD; Multiple Entry - 12 Months: 250.00 USD)
Validity of Visa approval : 90 days (from the day it was granted)

The following documents are required for Visa Application - Recent Photograph; Passport Copy (Bio Data Page); Covering letter from the host in Malawi (Must be signed by Host); Covering letter from Agent or Accommodation booking (Must be signed by Agent)

Below documents are required only if the Applicant is Minor: Birth Certificate (if Applicant is Minor); Passport Copy (Bio Data Page) of Guardian/ Parent (if Applicant is Minor); Form of Consent (if Applicant is Minor); Document Proof of Legal Guardianship (if not natural parent) (if Applicant is Minor)

steps.name: e-Visa Portal Login
notices: It requires you to give the travelers information as per the data page of your passport, travel details, photograph, and other related documents.
After completing the visa application form, you need to do online payment for the visa fee and convenience fee by your credit card or debit card Visa/Master.

forms.title: Malawi Traveller Health Check (Ministry of Health and Sanitation, Border Health)
forms.stoppedAt: Step 2 (About you: names, ID number, address, phone). Steps 3 and 4 were displayed by switching the page's own step counter, without entering any data.

steps.name: Your trip

fields.label: Where will you enter Malawi?
fields.notes: Type-ahead of entry points: airports (Kamuzu International, Chileka International, Club Makokola, Karonga), land borders (e.g. Mchinji (Mwami OSBP), Dedza, Mwanza, Songwe) and lake ports (Nkhata Bay, Chilumba, Chipoka).

fields.label: Which country are you coming from?
Countries you visited in the last 21 days

notices: Defaults to today. You can only declare up to 2 days ahead so your health status is current on arrival.
Add any you stayed in or passed through. Leave empty if none.

fields.label: Which country are you a citizen of?
Your home address (where you usually live)
Where will you stay in Malawi?
fields.notes: The first place you will sleep — hotel or address.

notices: Use the names on your passport or ID. All boxes here are needed.

steps.name: Your health

fields.label: Do you feel sick or have any symptoms today?

notices: This part is to keep everyone safe. Answer honestly.

steps.name: Confirm

fields.label: I understand and I agree. The details I gave are true.

notices: The Ministry of Health and Sanitation collects this information under the International Health Regulations and Malawian public-health law to keep travellers safe at the border.

We use it only for health screening and, if needed, to contact you. We check your answers for possible health risks and a health officer may follow up with you. Your details are kept for up to 100 days and then removed.
